lead_fa: Windwalker یک DPS میله‌ایِ پرتحرک است که هم‌زمان دو منبع Energy و Chi را مدیریت می‌کند و با [[Mastery: Combo Strikes]] پاداش تکرارنکردن اسپل‌ها را می‌گیرد؛ تعویض هدف تقریباً رایگان و موبیلتی تقریباً بی‌رقیب دارد. در Midnight دو مسیر Hero Tree پیش روی توست: [[Shado-Pan]] با آسیب یکنواخت و ساده برای همه‌جا، و [[Conduit of the Celestials]] با پنجره‌های برست متمرکز روی [[Celestial Conduit]].

strengths: Playstyle stays close to The War Within, so habits carry over
Little to no damage loss when switching targets
Talent choices can adjust how much rotational downtime you enjoy
Flexible cooldowns: swap between 60-second, 90-second and 2-minute cooldown windows with Zenith
weaknesses: No immunity or unique utility compared to many DPS specs
Desirability in groups often depends as much on Mistweaver and Brewmaster strength as on Windwalker itself

nerfs: Weapon of Wind: 5% damage during Zenith (was 10%)
buffs: Temple Training: 30% damage for Fists of Fury and Spinning Crane Kick (was 10%)
Vivify, Silent Sanctuary and Expel Harm healing increased by 25% to offset the 25% health/damage scaling
changes_12_1.note_12_1_5: Patch 12.1.5 brings no gameplay changes for Windwalker; only new gear (Kith'ix drops and Venomcore ilvl boosts).

hero.recommendation: Shado-Pan is the general recommendation and the pick for less experienced players: its damage is spread evenly across the whole toolkit and it wins wherever damage is not packed into one small burst window. Conduit of the Celestials is the advanced pick: much of its value comes from strictly timing Celestial Conduit against Heart of the Jade Serpent procs, and it is slightly stronger defensively (Niuzao's Protection / Jade Sanctuary choice nodes vs Shado-Pan's mostly PvP-oriented Whirling Steel / Predictive Training).
hero.shado_pan: Consistent damage profile: stacks buffs on the base kit instead of focusing one spell; AoE damage arrives naturally through Shado Over the Battlefield splashing Nature damage around you; opener mirrors the priority (get Fists of Fury and Rising Sun Kick on cooldown early).
hero.conduit_of_the_celestials: Burst profile: centers on Celestial Conduit and the summoned Celestials; Heart of the Jade Serpent (from Whirling Dragon Punch, Strike of the Windlord, Celestial Conduit and Zenith) accelerates cooldowns and Fists of Fury channels, squeezing large damage into the window; requires strict sequencing of the Heart of the Jade Serpent sources.
hero.comparison_source_note: Wowhead and Icy Veins agree: both heroes are competitively tuned; Shado-Pan = consistent AoE-friendly profile, Conduit of the Celestials = burst and low-target cleave with more defensive value.

concepts: Manage Energy and Chi: avoid capping either resource; keep enough Chi for spenders without overcapping; during major cooldowns overcapping is less punishing but still worth avoiding.
Keep abilities on cooldown: most Chi spenders have their own cooldowns (Rising Sun Kick, Fists of Fury); idle cooldown time is lost damage.
React to procs: Dance of Chi-Ji and Blackout Kick! can stack twice each; avoid overstacking them into waste, but do not be afraid to hold one briefly.
Do not repeat abilities: Mastery: Combo Strikes pays only when a cast differs from the previous one; Midnight added a last-cast tracking buff you can watch.
Do not repeat abilities: track the last-cast buff added in Midnight.
Avoid overcapping both Energy and Chi.
Use cooldown abilities like Rising Sun Kick and Fists of Fury as often as possible.
Plan Zenith usage: it is a 60/70/80/90-second cooldown with two charges; align it with Bloodlust, trinkets or high-damage phases.

cooldowns.Zenith: Resets Rising Sun Kick, grants 2 Chi, makes all Chi spenders cost 1 less and adds 1 second to Blackout Kick's cooldown reduction; during Zenith Blackout Kick is free and becomes the primary filler (with Obsidian Spiral it even generates Chi). Two charges: hold for Bloodlust, trinkets or burst phases instead of pressing instantly.
cooldowns.Celestial Conduit: Its biggest value is adding Heart of the Jade Serpent. The Zenith instance of the buff stacks with everything, but the Celestial Conduit instance does not stack with the ones from Strike of the Windlord or Whirling Dragon Punch: stagger those sources for maximum uptime and cancel the channel with the next GCD.
cooldowns.Invoke Xuen, the White Tiger: In Midnight it mainly exists to enable the Celestial Conduit channel right after; plan the GCDs so Xuen's summon does not delay your damage buttons.
cooldowns.Touch of Death: Use on cooldown; Fatal Touch no longer grants a damage buff after use. You may hold it for a target below 15% health whose total health is below your maximum health, for 100% of your maximum health instead of 35%, but missing that tiny window is a loss.
cooldowns.Touch of Karma: A defensive first: absorbs damage and redirects a share back. Offensively use it when you do not need the defensive value; stacking Fortifying Brew before it increases both the absorb and the redirect.
cooldowns.Fortifying Brew: Raises maximum health, which raises Touch of Death damage and Touch of Karma absorb; both snapshot on use, so press Fortifying Brew first when combining them.

pre_combat: Check your last cast: openers start with Tiger Palm, so cast Spinning Crane Kick well before the pull to rebuild Chi.
Place Transcendence outside the boss arena as a free teleport back.

gearing_rules: Rough guideline: Haste = Critical Strike = Mastery >>> Versatility; never neglect Agility.
A substantial item level increase generally outweighs secondary stat optimization; sim with Raidbots for real answers.
Upgrade priority: Weapon first (everything scales with Weapon DPS), then strong Trinkets, then lowest item level pieces (Helm, Chest, Legs first).
Ascendant Venomstone priority: Weapons, then Trinkets, then Neck (Aqirbane Reliquary).
Catalyze at least 3 non-tier pieces to keep the 4-piece bonus; any piece works, prefer ones without Versatility.

stats.cheatsheet: Agility >> Haste = Critical Strike = Mastery >>> Versatility; identical for Shado-Pan and Conduit of the Celestials, and roughly the same in AoE.
notes: Critical Strike became a significantly stronger secondary stat with the Midnight changes.
Haste increases Energy regeneration and lowers the cooldowns of Fists of Fury, Rising Sun Kick and Whirling Dragon Punch.
Mastery (Combo Strikes) increases damage of any cast that differs from the previous one.
Versatility is a good stat but sits behind the other three.
stats.dr_breakpoints: Diminishing returns start above: Critical Strike 1380, Haste 1320, Mastery 1380, Versatility 1620 rating (10% reduction per breakpoint, rating only; Bloodlust-style percentage buffs are unaffected).

mplus.hero_note: Shado-Pan is the recommended Hero Talent for Mythic+ (simple play, consistent AoE through Shado Over the Battlefield); Conduit of the Celestials can pull ahead if you strictly maximize its cooldown windows (Weekly Keys vs High Keys builds).
tips: Target swapping costs almost no damage, which is ideal for add-focused pulls and intermissions.
Mobility (Transcendence, high base movement) lets you handle dungeon mechanics with minimal DPS loss.
No immunity and weak defensives: plan Touch of Karma and Fortifying Brew before dangerous pulls; Fortifying Brew also boosts your Touch of Death burst.
Zenith's flexible 60/90-second cooldown with two charges adapts to trash packs and boss windows; align trinkets and potions with it.
Look for one powerful on-use trinket to pair with cooldowns plus a supplementary passive or proc trinket.
